“Dhritarashtra said, ‘O holy one, I did not like this business of
      gambling, but, O Muni, I think, I was made to consent to it drawn by fate!
      Neither Bhishma, nor Drona, nor Vidura, nor Gandhari liked this game at
      dice. No doubt, it was begot of folly. And, O thou who delightest in the
      observance of vows, O illustrious one, knowing everything yet influenced
      by paternal affection, I am unable to cast off my senseless son,
      Duryodhana!’
